scope: One fixed desktop pilot child; unrelated families and other variants are deferred.
expectation: I can give the app a fact in this conversation, ask about it in my next message, and receive the correct answer without losing or reordering either turn.
userGoals: I can give the app a fact in this conversation, ask about it in my next message, and receive the correct answer without losing or reordering either turn.
preconditions: Genuine invited non-admin test session, verified owner/consent and approved provider budget.
Exact deployed app in the verified existing Edge page; fresh empty test-owned thread; preserve and record actual viewport, scale and locale without emulation or focus.
Complete task/capture/heuristic and calibrated skill-bound semantic preparation must pass before any evaluated action.
cleanup: Drain capture, remove only runner-owned page bindings/scripts/routes/listeners and detach its CDP session; leave browser/context/page open. Driver exit disconnects transport. Retain attempts and conversation identities; no deletion or replay.
safety: At most2 submitted runs, exactly the fixed prompts, no automatic retries.
Keep90second overall and authored step deadlines;120request/20MiB network and24,000event/16MiB evidence ceilings; no implicit model-review spend.
Only whitelisted real app/API fields; never capture credentials, storage, headers or arbitrary run secrets.

heuristics.algorithm: Require two distinct submissions and accepted run/message pairs in one thread; compare actual terminal bodies exactly with ACK and MAPLE-27, not model plausibility or driver booleans.
inputs: real run status and message bodies
heuristics.pass: All required branch observations satisfy the exact algorithm in every retained state.
heuristics.fail: A supported mismatch, transient disappearance, chronology inversion, stale write or incorrect answer remains failure even after correction.
heuristics.insufficient: Missing required intermediate updates, association, cancellation, scroll/paint or calibrated capture is not a pass.
negativeCases: Correct final state after an intermediate failure
Wrong answer with driver success booleans
